title: Builder BLD-302: Email lens

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-302.

detail:
B3 Lenses, pass BLD-302 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-302). Email lens. Scope: components/builder/surfaces/email. Build: Email preview through compileEmailDoc; live blocks show their resolveAt: 'send' snapshot. Done when: The 7 draft campaigns and 7 templates render byte-identical to before. Gates: check:email-blocks, vitest suite (required test job), Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-301. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Email lens: the email surface compiles the page through compileEmailDoc from email-palette blocks (roles draw, freeze or hide per role.json; send-resolved blocks show the picked snapshot the send refreshes); the test holds the bytes to compileEmailDoc's and compiles the three starter templates through the same seam.
